name: OverloadedTrainsSimple-reforged
title: Overloaded Trains Simple Reforged (Paranoidal Fork)
author: SEO-master
description: Local Paranoidal fork. Train acceleration follows the real inertia of the carried cargo: item stacks and fluid add mass to the rolling stock weight, so the effect scales with the size of the train and its locomotives. Braking and top speed are unchanged; rolling stock is never replaced. This fork is not published on the Mod Portal.
